All four original scenario results now have photographed views. The user confirmed this is the complete photographic set from the first SSH setup/binding step onward; no additional photo uploads are expected. The final detector syntax/complete ten-file checksum check is supported by preserved text validation and transcript records and is not shown in this photo set. The second exact-boundary result upload shows the same terminal view as the recovered JPEG with different bytes; the total of 26 preserved JPEG files does not imply 26 independent camera acquisitions.
